title: Complete 3D Projection Gizmo
description: Rebuild the ad-hoc corner orbit gizmo into a complete projection navigation control: face/corner/center cube emitting WorldProjectionSpec, plus a family switcher exposing every taxonomy kind, with fixed snap pipeline so all transitions land correctly.
summary: Split WorldProjectionSpec into mode⊗orientation so gizmo and pane conjugate: gizmo sets cardinal/corner/free view only; pane sets Ortho/Axo/Obl/1–3pt/Curvilinear only. Top (and every other view) works with every projection mode. Template tree no longer lists Top/Front. vitest r3f 136 + framework 252 passed.
